race.comment: BORN TO FLY (9) has been well found in betting at both starts to date. Raced a bit closer last time out and battled on well for a close third over this distance at Kembla, a significant improvement on the debut performance. Can make further progress and play a key role. DON'T DOUBT DARCY (2) was having his first run in almost a year when runner-up over 1000m at Wyong on 29 October. Strips fitter and the extra 200m is going to help the cause. CHURCHILLIAN (1) has not raced since striking a heavy track and finishing third on debut at Canterbury in July. Trialled well at Rosehill recently and looks all set for a strong campaign. HIDDEN TYCOON (4) is a Stay Inside three-year-old on debut for Waterhouse/Bott. Has been to the trials six times since January, finishing fourth most recently at Randwick. Sure to go forward from the inside gate and give a good account. EXTREMELY CHIC (10) returned in good order at Kembla last start. Has come up pretty short due to the Waller/J Mac factor.
